question: Did the worker die of plague or a lab-acquired infection?

sideA.label: Rospotrebnadzor / Russia
sideA.text: No plague case recorded; no high-threat pathogen identified; no handling accidents found.

sideB.label: Early media reports
sideB.text: Reports of a broken tube of live bacteria and plague death.

resolution: Cause officially unestablished (pneumonia of unknown aetiology); WHO still seeking the pathogen.

question: Did a second lab employee fall ill?

sideA.label: Rospotrebnadzor
sideA.text: Reports of a second infection are fake.

sideB.label: Media reports
sideB.text: A second person reportedly fell ill after contact.

resolution: Unverified; WHO has asked about a possible second employee.
